data.one_liner: An extension to render LaTeX equations inside flutter_markdown widgets.
data.what_it_does: Extends the flutter_markdown package to parse and render both inline and block LaTeX expressions. It relies on flutter_math_fork under the hood to display mathematical formulas.
use_when: You need to display mathematical formulas written in LaTeX inside markdown text in a Flutter app.
You are already using flutter_markdown and want to add LaTeX rendering support.
avoid_when: You do not use markdown and just need standalone LaTeX rendering widgets.
You require a non-Flutter Dart environment.
strengths: Supports both inline and block LaTeX syntax.
Provides custom element builders for controlling text style and text scale factor.
weaknesses: Adds an extra configuration overhead to the standard markdown widget via specific extension sets and element builders.
